verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם יְרֻבַּ֜עַל ה֣וּא גִדְע֗וֹן וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ עֵ֣ין חֲרֹ֑ד וּמַחֲנֵ֤ה מִדְיָן֙ הָיָה־ ל֣וֹ מִצָּפ֔וֹן מִגִּבְעַ֥ת הַמּוֹרֶ֖ה בָּעֵֽמֶק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm yə·rub·ba·‘al hū ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tōw way·ya·ḥă·nū ‘al- ‘ên ḥă·rōḏ ū·ma·ḥă·nêh miḏ·yān hā·yāh- lōw miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn mig·giḇ·‘aṯ ham·mō·w·reh bā·‘ê·meq
verses.literal: Early in the morning Jerubbaal (that is Gideon and all the men with him camped beside the spring of Harod And the camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO Jerubaal (que é Gideão) se levantou de madrugada, e todo o povo que com ele havia, e se acamparam junto à fonte de Harode, de maneira que tinha o arraial dos midianitas para o norte, no vale, perto do outeiro de Moré.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ גִּדְע֔וֹן רַ֗ב הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֔ךְ מִתִּתִּ֥י אֶת־ מִדְיָ֖ן בְּיָדָ֑ם פֶּן־ יִתְפָּאֵ֨ר עָלַ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יָדִ֖י הוֹשִׁ֥יעָה לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn raḇ hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tāḵ mit·tit·tî ’eṯ- miḏ·yān bə·yā·ḏām pen- yiṯ·pā·’êr ‘ā·lay yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr yā·ḏî hō·wō·šî·‘āh lî
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Gideon You have too many men for Me to deliver Midian into their hands lest Israel glorify themselves over Me saying My own hand has saved me
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Gideão: Muito é o povo que está contigo, para eu dar aos midianitas em sua mão; a fim de que Israel não se glorie contra mim, dizendo: A minha mão me livrou.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְרָ֨א נָ֜א בְּאָזְנֵ֤י הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מִֽי־ יָרֵ֣א וְחָרֵ֔ד יָשֹׁ֥ב וְיִצְפֹּ֖ר מֵהַ֣ר הַגִּלְעָ֑ד וַיָּ֣שָׁב מִן־ הָעָ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים נִשְׁאָֽרוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qə·rā nā bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām lê·mōr mî- yā·rê wə·ḥā·rêḏ yā·šōḇ wə·yiṣ·pōr mê·har hag·gil·‘āḏ way·yā·šāḇ min- hā·‘ām ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm niš·’ā·rū
verses.literal: Now therefore proclaim in the hearing of the men . . . Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead So twenty-two . . . thousand of them turned back but ten thousand remained
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, apregoa aos ouvidos do povo, dizendo: Quem for medroso e tímido, volte, e retire-se apressadamente das montanhas de Gileade. Então voltaram do povo vinte e dois mil, e dez mil ficaram.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ גִּדְע֗וֹן עוֹד֮ הָעָ֣ם רָב֒ הוֹרֵ֤ד אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ הַמַּ֔יִם וְאֶצְרְפֶ֥נּוּ לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם וְהָיָ֡ה אֲשֶׁר֩ אֹמַ֨ר אֵלֶ֜יךָ זֶ֣ה׀ יֵלֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֗ךְ ה֚וּא יֵלֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֔ךְ וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֹמַ֜ר אֵלֶ֗יךָ זֶ֚ה לֹא־ יֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔ךְ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn ‘ō·wḏ hā·‘ām rāḇ hō·w·rêḏ ’ō·w·ṯām ’el- ham·ma·yim wə·’eṣ·rə·p̄en·nū lə·ḵā šām wə·hā·yāh ’ă·šer ’ō·mar ’ê·le·ḵā zeh yê·lêḵ ’it·tāḵ hū yê·lêḵ ’it·tāḵ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ō·mar ’ê·le·ḵā zeh lō- yê·lêḵ ‘im·māḵ hū lō yê·lêḵ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Gideon There are still too many men Take them down to the water and I will sift them for you there . . . If I say to you This one shall go with you he shall go . . . But if I say . . . This one shall not go with you he shall not go
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Gideão: Ainda há muito povo; faze-os descer às águas, e ali os provarei; e será que, daquele de que eu te disser: Este irá contigo, esse contigo irá; porém de todo aquele, de que eu te disser: Este não irá contigo, esse não irá.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹרֶד אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ הַמָּ֑יִםס וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ גִּדְע֗וֹן כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יָלֹק֩ בִּלְשׁוֹנ֨וֹ מִן־ הַמַּ֜יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר יָלֹ֣ק הַכֶּ֗לֶב תַּצִּ֤יג אוֹתוֹ֙ לְבָ֔ד וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִכְרַ֥ע עַל־ בִּרְכָּ֖יו לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·reḏ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’el- ham·må̄·yi·ms way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn kōl ’ă·šer- yā·lōq bil·šō·w·nōw min- ham·ma·yim ka·’ă·šer yā·lōq hak·ke·leḇ taṣ·ṣîḡ ’ō·w·ṯōw lə·ḇāḏ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yiḵ·ra‘ ‘al- bir·kāw liš·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Gideon brought the men down to the water and the LORD said to him Separate - those who lap the water with their tongues . . . like . . . a dog from those who kneel . . . . . . to drink
verses.literalPt: E fez descer o povo às águas. Então o SENHOR disse a Gideão: Qualquer que lamber as águas com a sua língua, como as lambe o cão, esse porás à parte; como também a todo aquele que se abaixar de joelhos a beber.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִסְפַּ֞ר הַֽמֲלַקְקִ֤ים בְּיָדָם֙ אֶל־ פִּיהֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וְכֹל֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם כָּרְע֥וּ עַל־ בִּרְכֵיהֶ֖ם לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî mis·par ha·mă·laq·qîm bə·yā·ḏām ’el- pî·hem šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš wə·ḵōl ye·ṯer hā·‘ām kā·rə·‘ū ‘al- bir·ḵê·hem liš·tō·wṯ mā·yim
verses.literal: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men all the others . . . knelt . . . . . . to drink . . .
verses.literalPt: E foi o número dos que lamberam, levando a mão à boca, trezentos homens; e todo o restante do povo se abaixou de joelhos a beber as águas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ גִּדְע֗וֹן בִּשְׁלֹשׁ֩ מֵא֨וֹת הָאִ֤ישׁ הַֽמֲלַקְקִים֙ אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ מִדְיָ֖ן בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְכָל־ הָעָ֔ם יֵלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn biš·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ hā·’îš ha·mă·laq·qîm ’ō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- miḏ·yān bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām yê·lə·ḵū ’îš lim·qō·mōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Gideon With the three hundred men who lapped the water I will save you and deliver the Midianites into your hand But all the others . . . are to go . . . home
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Gideão: Com estes trezentos homens que lamberam as águas vos livrarei, e darei os midianitas na tua mão; portanto, todos os demais se retirem, cada um ao seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֣וּ אֶת־ צֵדָה֩ הָעָ֨ם בְּיָדָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת שׁוֹפְרֹֽתֵיהֶ֗ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלַּח֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְאֹֽהָלָ֔יו וּבִשְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת הָאִ֖ישׁ הֶֽחֱזִ֑יק וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה מִדְיָ֔ן הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ מִתַּ֥חַת בָּעֵֽמֶק׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- ṣê·ḏāh hā·‘ām bə·yā·ḏām wə·’êṯ šō·wp̄·rō·ṯê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl šil·laḥ ’îš lə·’ō·hā·lāw ū·ḇiš·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ hā·’îš he·ḥĕ·zîq ū·ma·ḥă·nêh miḏ·yān hā·yāh lōw mit·ta·ḥaṯ bā·‘ê·meq
verses.literal: So Gideon sent . . . the rest of the Israelites . . . to their tents but kept the three hundred men who took charge of the provisions and rams’ horns of the others And the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley
verses.literalPt: E o povo tomou na sua mão a provisão e as suas buzinas, e enviou a todos os outros homens de Israel cada um à sua tenda, porém os trezentos homens reteve; e estava o arraial dos midianitas embaixo, no vale.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה ק֖וּם רֵ֣ד בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כִּ֥י נְתַתִּ֖יו בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bal·lay·lāh ha·hū way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw Yah·weh qūm rêḏ bam·ma·ḥă·neh kî nə·ṯat·tîw bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: That night the LORD said to Gideon Get up and go down against the camp for I have delivered it into your hand
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, naquela mesma noite, o SENHOR lhe disse: Levanta-te, e desce ao arraial, porque o tenho dado na tua mão.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יָרֵ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לָרֶ֑דֶת רֵ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה וּפֻרָ֥ה נַעַרְךָ֖ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yā·rê ’at·tāh lā·re·ḏeṯ rêḏ ’at·tāh ū·p̄u·rāh na·‘ar·ḵā ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: But if you are afraid to do so then go down to the camp . . . with your servant Purah
verses.literalPt: E, se ainda temes descer, desce tu e teu moço Purá, ao arraial;

verses.original: וְשָֽׁמַעְתָּ֙ מַה־ יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ וְאַחַר֙ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדֶ֔יךָ וְיָרַדְתָּ֖ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיֵּ֤רֶד הוּא֙ וּפֻרָ֣ה נַעֲר֔וֹ אֶל־ קְצֵ֥ה הַחֲמֻשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘·tā mah- yə·ḏab·bê·rū wə·’a·ḥar te·ḥĕ·zaq·nāh yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·yā·raḏ·tā bam·ma·ḥă·neh way·yê·reḏ hū ū·p̄u·rāh na·‘ă·rōw ’el- qə·ṣêh ha·ḥă·mu·šîm ’ă·šer bam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: and listen to what they are saying Then your hands will be strengthened to attack the camp So he went with Purah his servant to the outposts where armed men were guarding the camp
verses.literalPt: E ouvirás o que dizem, e então, fortalecidas as tuas mãos descerás ao arraial. Então desceu ele com o seu moço Purá até ao extremo das sentinelas que estavam no arraial.

verses.original: וּמִדְיָ֨ן וַעֲמָלֵ֤ק וְכָל־ בְּנֵי־ קֶ֙דֶם֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בָּעֵ֔מֶק כָּאַרְבֶּ֖ה לָרֹ֑ב וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם֙ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֔ר כַּח֛וֹל שֶׁעַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miḏ·yān wa·‘ă·mā·lêq wə·ḵāl bə·nê- qe·ḏem nō·p̄ə·lîm bā·‘ê·meq kā·’ar·beh lā·rōḇ wə·liḡ·mal·lê·hem ’ên mis·pār ka·ḥō·wl še·‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·yām lā·rōḇ
verses.literal: Now the Midianites Amalekites and all the other people of the east had settled in the valley like a swarm of locusts and their camels were as countless . . . as the sand on the seashore . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E os midianitas, os amalequitas, e todos os filhos do oriente jaziam no vale como gafanhotos em multidão; e eram inumeráveis os seus camelos, como a areia que há na praia do mar.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א גִדְע֔וֹן וְהִ֨נֵּה־ אִ֔ישׁ מְסַפֵּ֥ר לְרֵעֵ֖הוּ חֲל֑וֹם וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֵּ֧ה חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֗מְתִּי וְהִנֵּ֨ה צְלוֹל לֶ֤חֶם שְׂעֹרִים֙ מִתְהַפֵּךְ֙ בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה מִדְיָ֔ן וַיָּבֹ֣א עַד־ הָ֠אֹהֶל וַיַּכֵּ֧הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֛ל וַיַּהַפְכֵ֥הוּ לְמַ֖עְלָה וְנָפַ֥ל הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn wə·hin·nêh- ’îš mə·sap·pêr lə·rê·‘ê·hū ḥă·lō·wm way·yō·mer hin·nêh ḥă·lō·wm ḥā·lam·tî wə·hin·nêh ṣə·lōl le·ḥem śə·‘ō·rîm miṯ·hap·pêḵ bə·ma·ḥă·nêh miḏ·yān way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- hā·’ō·hel way·yak·kê·hū way·yip·pōl way·ya·hap̄·ḵê·hū lə·ma‘·lāh wə·nā·p̄al hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: And as Gideon arrived a man was telling his friend about a dream Behold I had a dream . . . he said and I saw a loaf of barley bread come . . . tumbling into the Midianite camp It struck the tent so hard that the tent overturned . . . and collapsed
verses.literalPt: Chegando, pois, Gideão, eis que estava contando um homem ao seu companheiro um sonho, e dizia: Eis que tive um sonho, eis que um pão de cevada torrado rodava pelo arraial dos midianitas, e chegava até à tenda, e a feriu, e caiu, e a transtornou de cima para baixo; e ficou caída.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן רֵעֵ֤הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ין זֹ֔את בִּלְתִּ֗י אִם־ חֶ֛רֶב גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נָתַ֤ן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ אֶת־ מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an rê·‘ê·hū way·yō·mer ’ên zōṯ bil·tî ’im- ḥe·reḇ giḏ·‘ō·wn ben- yō·w·’āš ’îš yiś·rā·’êl nā·ṯan hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·yā·ḏōw ’eṯ- miḏ·yān wə·’eṯ- kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: His friend . . . replied This is nothing less than . . . the sword of Gideon son of Joash the Israelite . . . God has delivered Midian and the whole camp into his hand
verses.literalPt: E respondeu o seu companheiro, e disse: Não é isto outra coisa, senão a espada de Gideão, filho de Joás, varão israelita. Deus tem dado na sua mão aos midianitas, e todo este arraial.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ גִּדְע֜וֹן אֶת־ מִסְפַּ֧ר הַחֲל֛וֹם וְאֶת־ שִׁבְר֖וֹ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ אֶל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ק֔וּמוּ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּיֶדְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵiš·mō·a‘ giḏ·‘ō·wn ’eṯ- mis·par ha·ḥă·lō·wm wə·’eṯ- šiḇ·rōw way·yiš·tā·ḥū way·yā·šāḇ ’el- ma·ḥă·nêh yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer qū·mū kî- nā·ṯan Yah·weh bə·yeḏ·ḵem ’eṯ- ma·ḥă·nêh miḏ·yān
verses.literal: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation he bowed in worship He returned to the camp of Israel and said Get up for the LORD has delivered the camp of Midian into your hand
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Gideão a narração deste sonho, e a sua explicação, adorou; e voltou ao arraial de Israel, e disse: Levantai-vos, porque o SENHOR tem dado o arraial dos midianitas nas nossas mãos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֛חַץ אֶת־ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת הָאִ֖ישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֑ים וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שׁוֹפָר֤וֹת בְּיַד־ כֻּלָּם֙ וְכַדִּ֣ים רֵקִ֔ים וְלַפִּדִ֖ים בְּת֥וֹךְ הַכַּדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ hā·’îš šə·lō·šāh rā·šîm way·yit·tên šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ bə·yaḏ- kul·lām wə·ḵad·dîm rê·qîm wə·lap·pi·ḏîm bə·ṯō·wḵ hak·kad·dîm
verses.literal: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other containing a torch
verses.literalPt: Então dividiu os trezentos homens em três companhias; e deu-lhes a cada um, nas suas mãos, buzinas, e cântaros vazios, com tochas neles acesas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מִמֶּ֥נִּי תִרְא֖וּ וְכֵ֣ן תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֥י בָא֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה כַאֲשֶׁר־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mim·men·nî ṯir·’ū wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śū wə·hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ḇā biq·ṣêh ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·hā·yāh ḵa·’ă·šer- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kên ta·‘ă·śūn
verses.literal: Watch me and do . . . as I do Gideon said . . . . . . When I come to the outskirts of the camp . . . do . . . exactly as I do
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Olhai para mim, e fazei como eu fizer; e eis que, chegando eu à extremidade do arraial, será que, como eu fizer, assim fareis vós.

verses.original: וְתָקַעְתִּי֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר אָנֹכִ֖י וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י וּתְקַעְתֶּ֨ם בַּשּׁוֹפָר֜וֹת גַּם־ אַתֶּ֗ם סְבִיבוֹת֙ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַיהוָ֥ה וּלְגִדְעֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·qa‘·tî baš·šō·w·p̄ār ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ’it·tî ū·ṯə·qa‘·tem baš·šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ gam- ’at·tem sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wa·’ă·mar·tem Yah·weh ū·lə·ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: When I and all who are with me blow our horns then you are also to blow your horns from all around the camp and shout For the LORD and for Gideon
verses.literalPt: Tocando eu a buzina, eu e todos os que comigo estiverem, então também vós tocareis a buzina ao redor de todo o arraial, e direis: Espada do SENHOR, e de Gideão.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א גִ֠דְעוֹן וּמֵאָה־ אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּ֜וֹ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה רֹ֚אשׁ הָאַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַתִּֽיכוֹנָ֔ה אַ֛ךְ הָקֵ֥ם הֵקִ֖ימוּ אֶת־ הַשֹּֽׁמְרִ֑ים וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וֹפָר֔וֹת וְנָפ֥וֹץ הַכַּדִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn ū·mê·’āh- ’îš ’ă·šer- ’it·tōw biq·ṣêh ham·ma·ḥă·neh rōš hā·’aš·mō·reṯ hat·tî·ḵō·w·nāh ’aḵ hā·qêm hê·qî·mū ’eṯ- haš·šō·mə·rîm way·yiṯ·qə·‘ū baš·šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ wə·nā·p̄ō·wṣ hak·kad·dîm ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch just after the changing . . . of the guard They blew their horns and broke the jars that were in their hands
verses.literalPt: Chegou, pois, Gideão, e os cem homens que com ele iam, ao extremo do arraial, ao princípio da vigília da meia noite, havendo sido de pouco trocadas as guardas; então tocaram as buzinas, e quebraram os cântaros, que tinham nas mãos.

verses.original: וַֽ֠יִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָרָאשִׁ֥ים בַּשּֽׁוֹפָרוֹת֮ וַיִּשְׁבְּר֣וּ הַכַּדִּים֒ וַיַּחֲזִ֤יקוּ בְיַד־ שְׂמאוֹלָם֙ בַּלַּפִּדִ֔ים וּבְיַ֨ד־ יְמִינָ֔ם הַשּׁוֹפָר֖וֹת לִתְק֑וֹעַ וַֽיִּקְרְא֔וּ חֶ֥רֶב לַֽיהוָ֖ה וּלְגִדְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qə·‘ū šə·lō·šeṯ hā·rā·šîm baš·šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ way·yiš·bə·rū hak·kad·dîm way·ya·ḥă·zî·qū ḇə·yaḏ- śə·m·ʾō·lå̄m bal·lap·pi·ḏîm ū·ḇə·yaḏ- yə·mî·nām haš·šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ liṯ·qō·w·a‘ way·yiq·rə·’ū ḥe·reḇ Yah·weh ū·lə·ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: The three companies blew their horns and shattered their jars Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns . . . in their right hands they shouted A sword for the LORD and for Gideon
verses.literalPt: Assim tocaram as três companhias as buzinas, e quebraram os cântaros; e tinham nas suas mãos esquerdas as tochas acesas, e nas suas mãos direitas as buzinas, para tocarem, e clamaram: Espada do SENHOR, e de Gideão.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֔יו סָבִ֖יב לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיָּ֧רָץ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה וַיָּרִ֖יעוּ וַיָּנִיסוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘am·ḏū ’îš taḥ·tāw sā·ḇîḇ lam·ma·ḥă·neh way·yā·rāṣ kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yā·rî·‘ū way·yå̄·nī·sū
verses.literal: Each Israelite took his position around the camp and the entire Midianite army fled crying out as they ran
verses.literalPt: E conservou-se cada um no seu lugar ao redor do arraial; então todo o exército pôs-se a correr e, gritando, fugiu.

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְקְעוּ֮ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֣וֹת הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת֒ וַיָּ֣שֶׂם יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת חֶ֥רֶב אִ֛ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֖הוּ וּבְכָל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיָּ֨נָס הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה עַד־ בֵּ֤ית הַשִּׁטָּה֙ צְֽרֵרָ֔תָה עַ֛ד שְׂפַת־ אָבֵ֥ל מְחוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ טַבָּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qə·‘ū šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ haš·šō·w·p̄ā·rō·wṯ way·yā·śem Yah·weh ’êṯ ḥe·reḇ ’îš bə·rê·‘ê·hū ū·ḇə·ḵāl ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yā·nās ham·ma·ḥă·neh ‘aḏ- bêṯ haš·šiṭ·ṭāh ṣə·rê·rā·ṯāh ‘aḏ śə·p̄aṯ- ’ā·ḇêl mə·ḥō·w·lāh ‘al- ṭab·bāṯ
verses.literal: And when the three hundred rams’ horns sounded the LORD set all the men in the camp against one another . . . with their swords The army fled to Beth-shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath
verses.literalPt: Tocando, pois, os trezentos as buzinas, o SENHOR tornou a espada de um contra o outro, e isto em todo o arraial, que fugiu para Zererá, até Bete-Sita, até aos limites de Abel-Meolá, acima de Tabate.

verses.original: וַיִּצָּעֵ֧ק אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִנַּפְתָּלִ֥י וּמִן־ אָשֵׁ֖ר וּמִן־ כָּל־ מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘êq ’îš- yiś·rā·’êl min·nap̄·tā·lî ū·min- ’ā·šêr ū·min- kāl- mə·naš·šeh way·yir·də·p̄ū ’a·ḥă·rê miḏ·yān
verses.literal: Then the men of Israel were called out from Naphtali Asher and all Manasseh and they pursued . . . the Midianites
verses.literalPt: Então os homens de Israel, de Naftali, de Aser e de todo o Manassés foram convocados, e perseguiram aos midianitas.

verses.original: וּמַלְאָכִ֡ים שָׁלַ֣ח גִּדְעוֹן֩ בְּכָל־ הַ֨ר אֶפְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר רְד֞וּ לִקְרַ֤את מִדְיָן֙ וְלִכְד֤וּ לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַיִּצָּעֵ֞ק כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וַיִּלְכְּד֣וּ אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·’ā·ḵîm šā·laḥ giḏ·‘ō·wn bə·ḵāl har ’ep̄·ra·yim lê·mōr rə·ḏū liq·raṯ miḏ·yān wə·liḵ·ḏū lā·hem ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim ‘aḏ bêṯ bā·rāh wə·’eṯ- hay·yar·dên way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘êq kāl- ’îš ’ep̄·ra·yim way·yil·kə·ḏū ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim ‘aḏ bêṯ bā·rāh wə·’eṯ- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim to say Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth-barah So all the men of Ephraim were called out and they captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah
verses.literalPt: Também Gideão enviou mensageiros a todas as montanhas de Efraim, dizendo: Descei ao encontro dos midianitas, e tomai-lhes as águas até Bete-Bara, e também o Jordão. Convocados, pois, todos os homens de Efraim, tomaram-lhes as águas até Bete-Bara e o Jordão.

verses.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּד֡וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ שָׂרֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן אֶת־ עֹרֵ֣ב וְאֶת־ זְאֵ֗ב וַיַּהַרְג֨וּ אֶת־ עוֹרֵ֤ב בְּצוּר־ עוֹרֵב֙ וְאֶת־ זְאֵב֙ הָרְג֣וּ בְיֶֽקֶב־ זְאֵ֔ב וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אֶל־ מִדְיָ֑ן וְרֹאשׁ־ עֹרֵ֣ב וּזְאֵ֔ב הֵבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶל־ גִּדְע֔וֹן מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kə·ḏū šə·nê- śā·rê miḏ·yān ’eṯ- ‘ō·rêḇ wə·’eṯ- zə·’êḇ way·ya·har·ḡū ’eṯ- ‘ō·w·rêḇ bə·ṣūr- ‘ō·w·rêḇ wə·’eṯ- zə·’êḇ hā·rə·ḡū ḇə·ye·qeḇ- zə·’êḇ way·yir·də·p̄ū ’el- miḏ·yān wə·rōš- ‘ō·rêḇ ū·zə·’êḇ hê·ḇî·’ū ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên
verses.literal: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb the two princes of Midian and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb . . . at the winepress of Zeeb So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: E prenderam a dois príncipes dos midianitas, a Orebe e a Zeebe; e mataram a Orebe na penha de Orebe, e a Zeebe mataram no lagar de Zeebe, e perseguiram aos midianitas; e trouxeram as cabeças de Orebe e de Zeebe a Gideão, além do Jordão.
